snippet.title: Ultramarine, The Retro Game
snippet.description:
Ultramarine the Retro Game is a freeware classic 16 bit videogame inspired by the world of Warhammer 40K.

In this game you will play with Darius, a brave Ultramarine, fighting against different enemies through the Warhammer 40K universe; using different weapons and habilities.

This game was created using the software Arcade Game Studio. Check it out!

Some background tilesets were created by Carl Olsson. Ckeck out his pixel-art.

By the way, Ultramarine The Retro Game is completely free, so please make sure you share it with your friends!

Visit www.comicsabelalves.com to download.
